title: Unsubscribe, preferences, re-subscribe, erasure and suppression
description: RFC 8058 one-click unsubscribe endpoint plus footer link page, preference centre (lists, re-subscribe, unsubscribe all, delete my data), SNS event consumer that suppresses hard bounces and complaints and records delivery events, per-site bounce/complaint alarms that pause the site configuration set. Done when the SES mailbox simulator bounce and complaint are suppressed and a one-click POST unsubscribes.

comments.author: home
comments.text: PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus/pull/536 merged to develop (CI green: python, ts, smoke). Manage-token links, one-click unsubscribe, preferences, erasure, SES event suppression, SNS subscription, bounce and complaint pause alarms, mailbox simulator script. Verified: typecheck, lint, plugin synth test, api test, pytest on moto, behave newsletter-unsubscribe. Alarm metric names are from the SES docs, not yet checked live. Not enabled on a site; story stays open until the live Shipped check.
